sourceOccurrences.label: Canonical bond graphs and cluster conventions
sourceOccurrences.relationship: Source-inspected statement correspondence with scope qualifications
sourceOccurrences.note: The product law, open graph, connection, cluster, two-point and extended susceptibility definitions are linked to the existing product-model, connectivity and susceptibility articles. Q0D1 and 0N0J explain adjacency, monotonicity, reflexive/symmetric/transitive connections, singleton clusters and non-vacuity on two vertices. GUHT and the concluding paragraph separate fixed-list cylinders and deterministic witness/escape identities from countable measurability. The source defines total measure expressions for arbitrary vertex types; the article uses probability terminology for connection and cluster observables only under its stated measurability hypotheses. Abbreviations and the probability-measure instance are not in the explicit definition/theorem count.

sourceOccurrences.locator: Named statement start lines in the pinned source: 21, 28, 35, 46, 52, 69, 75, 93
sourceOccurrences.note: 0N0J identifies clusters with component classes, including equality at a root and disjointness of distinct classes. TUD2 supplies finite real-valued root sums, the squared-size identity and the induced-domain specialization. The same finite counting argument gives the source natural-valued form. Window-intersection bounds and sampling interpretations are separate expository consequences, not claimed as exports from this module.
